description:
The agent must: (1) Read task_brief.json to extract calendar, note, and iMessage details. (2) Call scripts/create_calendar_event.sh with args in order: title, 'Work', '2026-07-14 09:00:00', '2026-07-14 11:30:00' — dates MUST be in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS locale-safe format per SKILL.md Compatibility Rule #1, not natural language. (3) Call scripts/create_note.sh where the FIRST argument is the note body rendered as HTML (must contain

and/or

tags per SKILL.md rule — plain text will fail) and the SECOND argument is 'iCloud'. (4) Call scripts/send_imessage.sh with 'david.lim@summit2026.com' as the FIRST argument (buddy) and the message text as the SECOND argument. The proprietary traps are: HTML-only body for Notes (a naive agent passes plain text), locale-safe datetime format for Calendar, and correct argument ordering (recipient-first) for iMessage.
